title: Absorb g copies of the heavy slice by the factor-9 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The `g` copies of the heavy slice fit the factor-9 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `9 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`, `g` copies of

```text
(p^{10})^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2)
```

are strictly below `2^{-C p}`. The gate forces `g < 2^L`, so the copies add one `L`. For `p ≥ 64`, `8 L ≤ p`, and `72 L` becomes `9 p`. Nine times the eighths is then at most `89 p + 72 - 36 p^2`. The polynomial `36 p^2 - 89 p - 144` equals `141616` at `p = 64` and increases by `72 p - 53`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

At `p = 128` and `g = 2`, `9 g L = 126 ≤ 128` while `10 g L = 140 > 128`, and the copies exponent is `-16236`. The published coefficient-9 monomial gate remains `16 g L ≤ p`. At `p = 2` and `g = 2` the hypothesis fails. Since `e < 3`, two copies are larger than `1`.

A factor smaller than `9` stays open. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`. This answers the open question of #4530. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_NINE_COPIES` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T03:53:24Z was that commit. The pre-submit fetch, reread at 2026-10-22T03:54:40Z, was unchanged, and the four pinned blobs match. κ remains `23/10000`.
